prerequisites: A newly invited DOC-029r2 access account for this role, invited by the seeded Administrator through the API, and its Mailpit set-password email.
Test preparation only: the account's first invitation token was expired in the lab database to exercise refusal.
scenarios.expected: The intended account reaches its permitted landing page; two-factor and session controls have their documented effects. Expired activation, incorrect password/code, and revoked-session behavior are observable without exposing another account.
scenarios.actual: 20 recorded account steps passed on 57e77e38, plus the unknown-address check and two supplementary rendering checks. The expired invitation link was refused with This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one. A link without its token said This link is not valid. Ask for a new invitation or password reset. After the Administrator re-sent the invitation, a password mismatch was refused with The passwords do not match., and Set password showed Password set with Sign in. The sign-in page showed Helix Software Group above the Sign in heading and form, with no Organization logo image, which matches the public branding answer (name saved, no logo). A wrong password was refused with Check your email and password., and the right password reached Home with the account name in the header. The consumed link was refused. Settings > Profile > Password & two-factor > Turn on two-factor asked for Password, showed the QR code and the manual secret, refused a wrong Code, accepted the current Code and showed 10 backup codes. After Done, Profile said two-factor is on and offered Re-enroll and Turn off two-factor. Password sign-in then opened Two-factor authentication: a wrong code was refused, the current code with Verify reached Home, a backup code worked once and its reuse was refused, and Sign out on the challenge page returned to sign-in. Sign out other devices sent a second browser to sign-in on reload while this session stayed. Re-enroll issued a new secret; closing the dialog before confirming left two-factor off and password-only sign-in worked. Turn off two-factor refused a wrong password, then removed the challenge, and Sign out in the name menu returned to sign-in. Email me a sign-in link signed the account in once; the reused link opened Sign-in link expired. Set up or reset your password showed the neutral Check your email text, the emailed link (60-minute token) set a new password, the old password was refused and the new one reached Home. An address outside the allowed domains got the same neutral page and no email. Supplementary, with mocked answers in the browser only: Continue with single sign-on, Administrator sign-in (which opens the password form) and Single sign-on is not configured yet render as the article says; a saved logo shows above the form, a logo that fails to load is hidden, and with no saved name the page shows OpenLaw.

prerequisites: A newly invited DOC-029r2 access account for this role, invited by the seeded Administrator through the API, and its Mailpit set-password email.

scenarios.expected: The intended account reaches its permitted landing page; two-factor and session controls have their documented effects. Expired activation, incorrect password/code, and revoked-session behavior are observable without exposing another account.
scenarios.actual: 19 recorded steps passed on 57e77e38 and 1 step was not run, for a newly invited Legal Team Member. Expired, token-less and consumed invitation links were refused with the documented messages. Mismatch and wrong password were refused. The sign-in page showed Helix Software Group above the Sign in heading and form with no logo, and Home opened with the account name in the header. Turn on two-factor used Password, QR code, manual secret, Code, Confirm, 10 backup codes and Done, then Profile said two-factor is on. At Two-factor authentication a wrong code was refused and the current code was accepted; a backup code worked once and its reuse was refused; Sign out on the challenge page restarted sign-in. Sign out other devices ended only the other browser's session. An abandoned Re-enroll left two-factor off. Turn off two-factor needed the password. Email me a sign-in link worked once and the reused link opened Sign-in link expired. Set up or reset your password (one-hour link) set a new password and the old one was refused. The wait time after repeated wrong codes was not observable in this lab and is recorded as not-run.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical reviewer. It is not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The work2 lab is shared with other DOC-029 round 2 agents. Seeded records and counts changed during the run. The walkthrough created only accounts and Contracts named DOC-029r2 access and changed no organization settings. Nothing was deleted. Three earlier attempts are kept as walkthrough-r2-1-attempt1.json, walkthrough-r2-1-attempt2.portal.json and walkthrough-r2-1-attempt3.json; their dispositions (reviewer script errors and too few rows for Show more) are in walkthrough-r2-1.json.
The lab app container runs with AUTH_RATE_LIMIT=off (lab configuration).

The seeded organization has no saved logo, and adding one needs an organization setting change that the shared lab does not allow. The live pages showed the organization name and no logo. A saved logo, a logo that fails to load, and no saved name were checked only as browser rendering with a mocked branding answer.

Single sign-on, Administrator sign-in and the server refusal Password sign-in is disabled for this account. need an organization-wide policy change, which the shared lab does not allow. Only the browser rendering was checked, with a mocked methods answer. No live identity provider was used.

Required two-factor authentication (the organization setting, the Your organization requires two-factor authentication. page and Required by your organization in Profile) was not exercised, for the same reason.
The wait time after repeated wrong codes was not observable because the lab disables the sign-in rate limiter (AUTH_RATE_LIMIT=off). The log records this step as not-run.
The five-minute link expiry was not waited out; the used-link refusal was observed. The one-hour password setup token lifetime was read from the lab database.
An Administrator landing on unfinished organization setup was not exercised; the lab onboarding is complete.

compatibilityReview.summary: From 57e77e38 to 432dba3a, round 3 found only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test changed. The wizard now goes to /auth/two-factor/enroll after it saves a policy that requires two-factor authentication. Read the article. It describes required two-factor enrollment after sign-in, Profile enrollment and the code challenge. The change only moves the setup wizard to /auth/two-factor/enroll after the wizard saves a policy that requires two-factor authentication. The enroll route, its loader and the session guard in lib/session.ts did not change, so every statement stays correct.
